Forwarding this thread to provide technical details Samir asked for. Short answers below: 

- Audit logs: hosted API audit logs are available via the Console under Observability > Audit Logs. Default retention: 90 days; extended retention options available per contract (we can pull an export sample in JSON).
- Access logs: request-level access logs are routed to your customer bucket when Dedicated/Private is configured; for Hosted we can provide periodic S3 export or a one-off export.
- Role-based session: happy to run a 45-minute deep-dive next Tue 11/17 10:00 PST (Marcus Lin, SE) — will cover KV eviction, warm-up, and best practices for latency-sensitive flows.
